messages:
Marta R: quick sync 1 cost flipbook card idea. single compact card that flips between: raw per-token burn, amortized cache savings, and per-model/unit econ. want fast compare canary vs stable without changing filters.
Jamal: can it keep the same time window & cohort filters? switching views today resets window which is really annoying.
Marta R: yes. plan is a small state blob saved with the card: view, sample_rate, cohort_id. e.g. view=amortized, sample_rate=0.1, cohort=canary-2026-03-20.
Ash: neat. UX q: when we show amortized savings we should surface uncertainty (confidence band or +/-). small deltas could be just noise.
Sana: also routing skew matters. if the canary hit a dedicated pool more, cache warmness will bias savings upward. we need to show routing breakdown and a "normalize for routing" toggle.
Marta R: proposal: show a one-line routing skew label (low/med/high) with a tooltip linking to routing breakdown for cohort. normalize toggle applies weights correction.
Jamal: compute cost? sampled estimate at 1% is cheap. full-res normalization will need a nightly pre-agg or on-demand recompute. default to sampled quick estimate + "recompute full" button.
DevEx Bot: reminder: metric names must use telemetry contract: tokens_total, tokens_cached, cache_hits, model_sku_cost. see: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/metrics/v2
Ash: add a pin-to-promptset compare. QA wants to compare same promptset across variants to isolate quality vs cost.
Sana: for normalization sketch: compute routing_bias = frac_to_dedicated(tenant) over window, then adjusted_cache_savings = raw_savings * (1 - routing_bias * alpha). alpha tunable by experiment.
Marta R: can ops expose frac_to_dedicated per cohort? ops-bot, ping infra.
ops-bot: @SRE Oncall can you export routing-destination breakdowns per cohort for last 7 days at 1h granularity? low priority but useful.
Sana: if ops provides that, we can precompute normalized views nightly and keep a sampled live estimate.
Jamal: API shape question: single endpoint with mode param (mode=amortized) or separate endpoints? prefer single endpoint + mode param so auth/caching consistent.
DevEx Bot: note: new endpoint must be added to SDK changelog. @Marta R file a quick RFC.
Marta R: next steps: I'll draft the API, build a small prototype card in dev console, and an alpha experiment plan. will post proto link here.
Ash: add a small banner when sample_rate < 1 explaining extra uncertainty.
Jamal: also include a historic baseline sparkline so diffs read easier.
Marta R: thanks all 1 will post the prototype link once it's up.
root_message_text: proto for a compact cost flipbook card to toggle per-token, amortized cache-savings, and per-model econ; debating routing normalization, sampling, and API shape
